tools.name: Coldbox
tools.capability: Run CI jobs in disposable VMs on your own hardware.
tools.json: coldbox status --json. The API uses exit codes 75 and 125 for retry and infrastructure failure.

tools.name: Coldcleaner
tools.capability: Preview disk cleanup and verify archives before deleting files.
tools.json: coldcleaner doctor --json reports prerequisites. Exit 0 means success, 1 a finding or refusal, and 2 an error.

tools.name: Coldlocker
tools.capability: Share skills, rules, hooks and MCP across agents.
tools.agent_entrypoints: Connect a client to the stdio MCP endpoint, then use hub_list_skills and hub_get_item.

tools.name: Coldfix
tools.capability: Scan for recurring agent mistakes and rerun proofs from the lesson library.
tools.json: coldfix check --json REPO exits 0 for clean, 1 for findings and 2 for incomplete or error.
tools.agent_entrypoints: See the repository for ColdRecall hook setup.

tools.name: Coldvault
tools.capability: Search a local vault of agent conversations and repository notes.
tools.json: python3 coldvault.py search QUERY --json --vault VAULT returns an object with schema_version 1 and a hits array. Exit 0 means matches, 1 means no matches, and 2 returns a JSON object with an error field.

tools.name: Coldpass
tools.capability: Browse public README trial results and run evidence.
tools.json: Read the public API at https://coldpass.dev/api/v1/index.json.
tools.agent_entrypoints: The downloadable client provides stdio MCP. See https://coldpass.dev/llms.txt.

tools.name: Coldrelease
tools.capability: Scan and verify an export before making it public.
tools.json: coldrelease --version --json and coldrelease audit . --json report schema version 1.

tools.name: Coldverify
tools.capability: Replay an observed failure and its fix across two revisions.
tools.json: coldverify --version --json returns schema_version, exit_code and version data.

tools.name: Coldguardian
tools.capability: Check approved home networks for changes and risky services.
tools.json: coldguardian status --json validates local configuration without starting a scan.

tools.name: ColdRewind
tools.capability: Checkpoint a workspace and restore local files and Git state.
tools.json: coldrewind status --json reports the workspace snapshot backend and last capture error.
tools.agent_entrypoints: coldrewind init --client claude installs hooks for Claude Code. The codex and opencode clients are also supported.

tools.name: Coldcontribute
tools.capability: Find contribution opportunities requested by maintainers.
